key_points: May retail disbursals 902 CR vs 903 CR target (99%); NR at 74% of AOP due to LAB mix and payout leakage.
CM1 improved dramatically from -33L to -2.4L as pay-in controls and special-deal scheme tightening took effect.
LAB drop driven by Bombay + Bangalore underperformance; 40 CR spill into June with ~25 CR net benefit.
ICICI deal corrected effective June; NR from ICICI expected to nearly double going forward.
BM productivity improved from 4.44 to 5.19 logins per BM.
Scorecard system launched: every RM, BM, and sales head now receives monthly weighted NR score with rank; bottom 20-25% on intensive PIP/termination review cycle.
Out-of-system business fully eliminated from June — all cases must be in Sangam before reporting.
Q2 incentive structure (July–September) being redesigned to link Z/CH pay to NR, not just disbursement volume.
PST: 102 onboardings in May (highest ever), 12 disbursal activations. ABPS improved 3.7→5.1, AMPS 2.3→3.4. Audit tracker and PST Ops launched.
Sankalp: 33 total events, 138 CR unique disbursals, 450 CR lifetime business from those partners.
Training: NHST revamped with micro-modules; Learning Premier League (Kahoot) live; 30-day assessment launching next week; simulation videos built.
Raghu proposed cross-team LPL on shared skills (sales confidence, objection handling) to raise common bar across verticals.
decisions: Q2 incentive structure (July–September) to link Z/CH compensation to NR, not disbursement volume; Ashish working on math.
Gamification + RM buddy hero-feature brainstorm session to be held Tuesday evening (Vikas, Vijay, Pankaj, Rameshwar); physical if Vikas in Delhi.
Out-of-system reporting permanently eliminated from June; only system-tracked cases count.
Performance scorecard released for all BMs today; sales-head scorecards also releasing today.
Bottom-performer intensive review (PIP / termination decisions) to run monthly using scorecard ratings.
PST dual-plan expansion: Plan 1 (PST + ABM model) 50% deployed in Delhi/Noida; Plan 2 (offline beat-mapping) launched.
